entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese metadata, all eleven turns and five hints against every full target set. Checked accessible audio timetable, Osaka left button, Today/local filters, two times, replay, stop and earphone return before platform. Removed unsupported afternoon specificity in Thai.

Read full Japanese booking context and all twelve target sets including hints. Verified ten to six attendees, booking 218, Tuesday 13-15, same room, circle rather than two rows, self-movement and restoration using wall diagram. Corrected Khmer room-count wording to attendee count.

Read full Japanese discharge context and twelve translations with all hints. Confirmed blue cloth bag/name, frozen cooling pillow, own white towel, glasses already returned yesterday, bag closure and discharge reception. Refrigerated/frozen wording is source scope; no medical instruction added.

Read all Japanese metadata, eleven turns and five hints against twelve complete target sets. Verified unstable home connection, city-office private terminal, job consultation at two, earphones, own-voice test, connect at appointment, end button and reception notification.

Read Japanese and all twelve complete translations/hints. Verified painful inner cheek, bread crust/grilled meat difficult, porridge tolerated, no choking with water, one bite and all porridge, adjustment only after staff confirmation. Corrected Chinese unpalatable ambiguity and Khmer bite spelling.

Read full Japanese context and twelve translation/hint sets. Checked stopped repeated night noise, about one for twenty minutes, east side without identified building, no confirmed fight/injury, date/start/end notes, consultation possible without recording. Corrected Thai duration versus start-time ambiguity.

Read Japanese metadata, all turns/hints and twelve targets. Verified Vietnam friend address copied in Roman letters, final-line country VIETNAM, sender JAPAN for return, airmail preference, weighing before charge explanation and dispatch. Corrected Indonesian request for price information.

Read full Japanese scenario and all twelve translation/hint sets. Verified literal transfer-party context, グエン versus グェン distinction, passbook and ID, Roman spelling check, next-month salary use not yet submitted, registration confirmed before employer notification. Corrected Traditional Chinese identity-document term.

Read Japanese and twelve complete target sets, including all hints. Checked payment then outer-box removal, one bottle not refill, bottle label versus instructions inside box, cutting and preserving instructions, retailer retaining remaining box, own bag and paper instruction bag. No semantic correction needed.

Read Japanese metadata and complete twelve target sets/hints. Checked red handle mark upper orientation, backing for thin notebook paper, light ink-pad contact then vertical press, faint edge and second-page retry, equal four-corner pressure, return stamp and leave notebook open until dry.

Read full Japanese and all twelve targets/hints. Checked pillar-blocked announcement, current train terminating Minamimachi, next direct Kitamachi arriving sooner in six minutes, side displays, move forward behind yellow line and wait where visible. Corrected Chinese next-train wording and Vietnamese direct-service clarity.

Read Japanese metadata/turns/hints and every twelve-language target set. Verified four display panels in two round trips, two retained, flat stacking with cloth rather than upright, blanket protecting metal, fittings/instructions first, twenty-minute return and exhibition-room unloading before collection.

Read Japanese and all twelve complete target sets. Verified right foot alone not fitting, new this morning versus same shoes yesterday, no pain but instep tension, staff contacting rehab, seated wait/help removing left shoe and checking exercise permission before starting. Corrected Khmer onset/notice wording.

Read Japanese and all twelve complete translation/hint sets. Verified fresh lock scratches, closed door/key hard to turn, management contacted/person coming/photos taken, normal at 21 yesterday and found 07 today, no person witnessed and question on pre-repair inspection; no cause or suspect inferred.

Read Japanese metadata/eleven turns/five hints against twelve full target sets. Verified other-party reply envelope missing postcode, full address used rather than building alone, sender on back, existing stamps checked by weighing, sufficient postage and retaining code for next reply. No new postal rule inferred.

Read full Japanese and twelve translations with every hint. Verified bicycle red-light movement, pedestrian stopping, two close signals, second intersection before river not shop, map path, about 17:10 toward bridge, no contact/fall witnessed and limits of observation retained.

Read all Japanese metadata, turns and hints against twelve target sets. Verified two contacts same company/department, inner envelopes named individually and outer company address, thickness/weight/pricing, tracked method, both letters checked before sealing, tracking receipt stored in work file.

Read Japanese and all twelve full translation/hint sets. Checked regular 15000 yen, first 18000, 3000 difference, tentative explanation before staff confirmation, longer first interest period specific to this schedule, second payment/date and budget. Corrected deictic date and omitted thousand units in Bengali/Nepali.

Read Japanese and twelve targets/hints. Checked six bags each 200g equals 1.2kg, skin-on chicken thigh, tomorrow 10 AM, weight labels, meat-counter refrigerated holding, all six inside insulated bag with space for cooling packs, Mori reservation. Corrected Chinese fit direction.

Read complete Japanese context plus all twelve translation/hint sets. Verified reflection obstruction, shaded stone/view within fence, fish under right water plants, tentative back-shape photograph match without species claim, red stripe and entrance-relative position recorded before staff explanation.

Read Japanese metadata, eleven turns and hints against every full twelve-language set. Verified unusable usual stairs, rear temporary detour and other stairs, about three extra walking minutes, 09:20 versus chosen 09:35, narrow passage/no running, open area signs for both directions and platform two toward Minamimachi.

Read Japanese full context and all twelve targets/hints. Distinguished issued original from photocopy, two submission destinations and their own instructions, photocopy before giving original to school, receipt number on copy margin only, one original requested, type/count on application. Corrected Hindi recipient identity.

Read Japanese and twelve complete translation/hint sets. Verified post-night-shift 09 sleep/15 wake versus days-off 23 sleep/07 wake, one-hour pre-shift nap, dawn waking only as days-off problem, continuous daytime sleep, two night shifts weekly and doctor discussion. Corrected single-time versus one-hour ambiguity.

Read Japanese and all twelve complete target/hint sets. Verified visitor only claiming police, no uniform/name unclear, hour ago/departed/evening return/card, no account disclosure or entry/no card-number call, verify before opening, recorded face/time on phone. Corrected no-uniform versus no-clothes wording and entry subject.

Read Japanese metadata/eleven turns/five hints and twelve full targets. Verified lodging acceptance, guest Saturday arrival date beside name versus Friday parcel delivery, postal address inside email matched to label, deadlines unguaranteed and self-carry fallback, decision after shipment conditions. Corrected email-address ambiguity.

Read Japanese and all twelve full targets/hints. Verified 50000 yen entered versus 3000 management and 53000 total, current notice/year-old memory, preacceptance correction/new form/old handover, fee increase this month, no automatic transfer and next-month notice check. Restored explicit yen where every amount lacked currency.

Read Japanese and twelve complete target sets/hints. Verified two water bottles versus small bag/egg carton, walking home/reduce one before checkout, water bottom eggs top, fit trial with carton flat not on edge, no extra bag, restore basket/pay before final packing. Corrected Tagalog checkout versus counting wording.

Read all Japanese context, turns and hints against twelve complete target sets. Verified loose pear 200 yen versus three-bag 540 and loose-three 600, smaller bag fruit caveat, two people share one large loose fruit, per-piece not weight, select from loose shelf without opening bags, checkout quantity.

Read Japanese metadata/eleven turns/five hints and all twelve complete targets. Verified north-up versus south-facing reversal, rotating map to current scenery, entrance near side, left path past round shop to pond, reorienting on return with entrance/shop landmarks rather than blindly restoring original map position.

changes.before: ได้ยินบ่ายสองสิบนาทีกับบ่ายสองยี่สิบห้า ฟังเวลาแรกอีกได้ไหมคะ
changes.after: ได้ยินเวลาสองนาฬิกาสิบนาทีกับสองนาฬิกายี่สิบห้านาที ฟังเวลาแรกอีกครั้งได้ไหมคะ
changes.reason: Japanese gives two ten and two twenty-five without specifying afternoon; preserve that scope.

changes.before: ฟังอีกแล้วแน่ใจบ่ายสองสิบ จะกดหยุด คืนหูฟังแล้วไปชานชาลาเที่ยวนั้นค่ะ
changes.after: ฟังอีกครั้งแล้วแน่ใจว่าเป็นเวลาสองนาฬิกาสิบนาที จะกดหยุด คืนหูฟัง แล้วไปชานชาลาของรถไฟเที่ยวนั้นค่ะ
changes.reason: Avoid adding afternoon when source time has no AM or PM designation; retain action sequence.

changes.before: ការជួបសប្តាហ៍ក្រោយពីដប់មកប្រាំមួយនាក់។ ចង់ប្តូរចំនួនបន្ទប់ដែលកក់។
changes.after: ការជួបជុំសប្តាហ៍ក្រោយបានប្តូរពីដប់នាក់ទៅប្រាំមួយនាក់។ ខ្ញុំចង់កែចំនួនអ្នកប្រើប្រាស់បន្ទប់ដែលបានកក់។
changes.reason: The source changes attendees for the reserved room, not the number of reserved rooms.

changes.before: 我嘴里面痛，硬的菜很难吃。我想咨询一下餐食的形态。
changes.after: 我嘴里面痛，硬的菜很难咀嚼。我想咨询一下餐食的形态。
changes.reason: Clarify physical difficulty eating hard food rather than describing the food as unpalatable.

changes.before: 我嘴裡面痛，硬的菜很難吃。我想諮詢一下餐食的形態。
changes.after: 我嘴裡面痛，硬的菜很難咀嚼。我想諮詢一下餐食的形態。
changes.reason: Clarify physical difficulty eating hard food rather than describing the food as unpalatable.

changes.before: បបរអស់ សាច់មួយម៉ាត់។ សូមប្រាប់បរិមាណនិងឈឺថ្ពាល់ទៅអ្នកទទួលបន្ទុក។
changes.after: បបរញ៉ាំអស់ សាច់មួយមាត់។ សូមប្រាប់បរិមាណនោះនិងការឈឺថ្ពាល់ទៅអ្នកទទួលបន្ទុក។
changes.reason: Correct the Khmer word for a mouthful and preserve sharing the exact amounts and cheek pain.

changes.before: เมื่อคืนตั้งแต่ประมาณตีหนึ่งยี่สิบนาที ได้ยินจากตะวันออกของบ้าน แต่ไม่รู้ถึงตัวอาคารค่ะ
changes.after: เมื่อคืนเริ่มประมาณตีหนึ่งและดังอยู่นานยี่สิบนาที ได้ยินจากทิศตะวันออกของบ้าน แต่ไม่ทราบว่าเป็นอาคารไหนค่ะ
changes.reason: Separate the start time around 1 AM from the twenty-minute duration; previous wording reads as 1:20 AM.

changes.before: Ini amplopnya. Nama negara sudah ditulis, jadi tolong beri ongkos pos udara lalu kirimkan.
changes.after: Ini amplopnya. Nama negara sudah ditulis, jadi tolong jelaskan ongkos pos udara lalu kirimkan.
changes.reason: The customer asks to be told the airmail charge, not to be given money for postage.

changes.before: 您帶存折和身分證明檔案了嗎？
changes.after: 您帶存摺和身分證明文件了嗎？
changes.reason: Use the natural term for identification documents rather than electronic files in the physical bank-counter context.

changes.before: 这班只到途中南町，北町是下班。
changes.after: 这班列车只到途中的南町站。开往北町的是下一班。
changes.reason: The source means the next train, whereas 下班 commonly means getting off work.

changes.before: 這班只到途中南町，北町是下班。
changes.after: 這班列車只到途中的南町站。開往北町的是下一班。
changes.reason: The source means the next train, whereas 下班 commonly means getting off work.

changes.before: Hôm nay trực tiếp sau đến trước. Sáu phút nữa tới.
changes.after: Hôm nay chuyến tàu chạy thẳng tiếp theo sẽ đến nơi sớm hơn. Sáu phút nữa tàu sẽ tới đây.
changes.reason: Clarify direct train arrives at destination earlier while the six-minute wait is for its arrival here.

changes.before: Tôi chờ trực tiếp. Chỉ đầu tàu có bảng đích ạ?
changes.after: Vậy tôi sẽ chờ chuyến chạy thẳng. Bảng hiển thị điểm đến chỉ có ở đầu tàu thôi ạ?
changes.reason: Render direct train naturally and preserve the question about the destination display location.

changes.before: Cảm ơn. Lúc xếp hai đầu, chở dựng đứng được không?
changes.after: Cảm ơn. Khi xếp hai tấm đầu tiên lên xe, tôi có thể chở dựng đứng được không?
changes.reason: Specify the first two panels; prior wording hai đầu can mean the two ends rather than two panels.

changes.before: प्रदर्शनी में उतारकर बाकी लेने का क्रम पूछें। जापानी में कहें।
changes.after: प्रदर्शनी कक्ष में सामान उतारकर लौटने और बाकी दो पैनल लेने का क्रम पक्का करें। जापानी में कहें।
changes.reason: The hint asks the learner to confirm their action sequence rather than ask for a new sequence.

changes.before: កុំបង្ខំ សូមមើលជើង តាំងពីណា?
changes.after: កុំពាក់ដោយបង្ខំ សូមឱ្យខ្ញុំមើលសភាពជើង។ ចាប់ផ្តើមតាំងពីពេលណា?
changes.reason: Ask when the condition began, not where it began; keep the no-forcing instruction.

changes.before: ស្គាល់ព្រឹកនេះ ម្សិលមិញស្បែកជើងដដែលពាក់បាន។
changes.after: ខ្ញុំទើបចាប់អារម្មណ៍ឃើញព្រឹកនេះ។ ម្សិលមិញខ្ញុំអាចពាក់ស្បែកជើងដដែលបាន។
changes.reason: Translate noticed this morning rather than became acquainted; retain yesterday contrast.

changes.before: 没人看到，想告诉管理公司是否需要修前让您确认。
changes.after: 我没有看到任何人。我也想告诉管理公司，修理之前是否需要请您来查看。
changes.reason: Preserve that the speaker saw nobody; prior 没人看到 could instead claim nobody witnessed the event.

changes.before: 沒人看到，想告訴管理公司是否需要修前讓您確認。
changes.after: 我沒有看到任何人。我也想告訴管理公司，修理之前是否需要請您來查看。
changes.reason: Preserve that the speaker saw nobody; prior 沒人看到 could instead claim nobody witnessed the event.

changes.before: จากวันนี้ถึงตรงนี้สินะคะ แรกจะเตรียมหนึ่งหมื่นแปดพันค่ะ
changes.after: ช่วงจากวันที่นี้ถึงตรงนี้สินะคะ ครั้งแรกจะเตรียมหนึ่งหมื่นแปดพันเยนค่ะ
changes.reason: This source date points to a date on the schedule and does not mean today.

changes.before: ពីថ្ងៃនេះដល់ទីនេះ។ ខ្ញុំត្រៀមមួយម៉ឺនប្រាំបីពាន់ដំបូង។
changes.after: គឺរយៈពេលពីកាលបរិច្ឆេទនេះដល់ត្រង់នេះមែនទេ។ ខ្ញុំនឹងត្រៀមមួយម៉ឺនប្រាំបីពាន់យ៉េនសម្រាប់លើកដំបូង។
changes.reason: The date is pointed out on the schedule, not asserted to be today.

changes.before: សួរភាពខុសប្រាក់ខែនិងដំបូងលើតារាង។ សូមនិយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.after: សួរអំពីភាពខុសគ្នារវាងចំនួនសងប្រចាំខែនិងចំនួនសងលើកដំបូងនៅលើតារាង។ សូមនិយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.reason: The monthly amount is loan repayment, not salary as ប្រាក់ខែ can mean.

changes.before: না, দ্বিতীয় থেকে পনেরো, প্রথম তিন হাজার তফাৎ জানতে চাই।
changes.after: এখনও নয়। দ্বিতীয় কিস্তি থেকে পনেরো হাজার ইয়েন, তাই প্রথম কিস্তির তিন হাজার ইয়েনের পার্থক্যটা জানতে চাই।
changes.reason: Retain the explicit fifteen-thousand-yen amount rather than fifteen.

changes.before: দ্বিতীয় তারিখ ও পনেরো দেখেছি। সংসারের হিসাবে প্রথমে আলাদা টাকা রাখব।
changes.after: দ্বিতীয় কিস্তির তারিখ ও পনেরো হাজার ইয়েনও যাচাই করেছি। সংসারের বাজেটে শুধু প্রথম কিস্তির জন্য আলাদা অঙ্ক রাখব।
changes.reason: Retain fifteen thousand yen and make the first-only budgeting distinction explicit.

changes.before: अझै होइन। दोस्रोदेखि पन्ध्र, पहिलो तीन हजारको फरक जान्नुछ।
changes.after: अझै होइन। दोस्रो किस्तादेखि पन्ध्र हजार येन भएकाले पहिलोको तीन हजार येन फरकको कारण जान्न चाहन्छु।
changes.reason: Preserve thousands and yen for the repayment and its difference.

changes.before: गरिदिनुहोस्। पहिलोमा पनि पन्ध्र मात्र तयारी भन्ने सोचेँ।
changes.after: कृपया जाँचिदिनुहोस्। पहिलो किस्ताका लागि पनि पन्ध्र हजार येन मात्र तयार गरे पुग्छ भन्ने सोचेको थिएँ।
changes.reason: The mistaken preparation amount is fifteen thousand yen, not fifteen.

changes.before: दोस्रो मिति र पन्ध्र पनि हेरेँ। घर बजेटमा पहिलो मात्र अलग रकम राख्छु।
changes.after: दोस्रो किस्ताको मिति र पन्ध्र हजार येन पनि जाँचेँ। घरको बजेटमा पहिलो किस्ताका लागि मात्र फरक रकम राख्छु।
changes.reason: Retain the explicit fifteen-thousand-yen second repayment amount.

changes.before: 在这取。六个袋子装得下这个保温袋吗？
changes.after: 我在这里取。这六个小袋都装得进这个保冷袋吗？
changes.reason: The six small meat bags must fit inside the insulated bag, not contain the insulated bag.

changes.before: 在這取。六個袋子裝得下這個保溫袋嗎？
changes.after: 我在這裡取。這六個小袋都裝得進這個保冷袋嗎？
changes.reason: The six small meat bags must fit inside the insulated bag, not contain the insulated bag.

changes.before: जमा करने वाला प्रतिलिपि लेता हो तो निर्देश में क्या कॉपी करना है भी देखें। निर्देश हैं?
changes.after: यदि जिस संस्था में जमा करना है वह प्रतिलिपि स्वीकार करती है, तो निर्देशों में यह भी जाँच लें कि किसकी कॉपी करनी है। क्या निर्देश साथ हैं?
changes.reason: The party accepting the copy is the submission destination, not the person submitting it.

changes.before: Sau ca đêm ngủ 9 giờ sáng. Ngày nghỉ 11 giờ đêm nên chỉ một giờ không đúng.
changes.after: Sau ca đêm tôi ngủ lúc 9 giờ sáng. Ngày nghỉ thì 11 giờ đêm, nên chỉ ghi một mốc giờ sẽ không đúng.
changes.reason: Clarify a single clock-time entry rather than a one-hour sleep duration.

changes.before: ក្រោយវេនគេងប្រាំបួនព្រឹក។ ថ្ងៃឈប់ដប់មួយយប់ ដូច្នេះមួយម៉ោងមិនត្រូវ។
changes.after: ក្រោយវេនយប់ ខ្ញុំគេងម៉ោងប្រាំបួនព្រឹក។ ថ្ងៃឈប់គឺម៉ោងដប់មួយយប់ ដូច្នេះសរសេរតែម៉ោងចូលគេងមួយមិនត្រូវទេ។
